sentences.en: Surely the most curious of sources consulted is Mankind Quarterly.
sentences.zh: 当然，查阅过《人类季度刊》这个最奇怪的来源确实让人好奇。

sentences.en: As to the source of this statement, I know nothing.
sentences.zh: 至于这句话的出处，我一无所知。

sentences.zh: 赌博并非他唯一的收入来源。
